description: This source file defines an ASP.NET Core API controller named CommandsController, which manages CRUD operations and related functionalities for Command entities within a REST API. It handles creating, updating, retrieving (single and multiple), deleting commands, as well as uploading output files and discovering output parsers. The controller also includes auxiliary classes and methods for processing command-related jobs.

classes.name: CommandProcessorJob
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a job to process command output, including identifiers and file path.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Creates a new Command entity based on the request body and returns the created entity.

methods.name: UpdateOne
methods.description: Updates an existing Command entity identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of Command entities, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Fetches a single Command entity by its ID, including related Creator data.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a Command entity by its ID and logs the deletion for auditing.

methods.name: GetOutputParsers
methods.description: Returns a list of available output parsers discovered by the ProcessorIntegrationDiscovery.

methods.name: UploadOutput
methods.description: Handles uploading an output file for a command, storing it, computing its hash, and optionally enqueueing a processing task.
